evals.prompt: 다음 확정된 시놉시스를 정확히 6개 패널로 스토리보드화해 주세요. 비 오는 밤, 한 학생이 늦게까지 불이 켜진 문구점 창가 진열을 따라 할머니가 잃어버린 편지를 찾습니다. 편지는 할머니가 창가 진열함 안에 끼워 둔 채 비를 피해 있었습니다.
evals.expected_output: A six-panel Korean visual storyboard with one readable action per panel, motivated progression, foreshadowed discovery, and a consistent six-cell sheet prompt.
expectations: Exactly six ordered panels, each centered on one readable visible action or beat.
Panel transitions follow the supplied premise rather than unrelated invented events.
The window display or its sheltered interior is visually foreshadowed before the letter is discovered, and the final panel resolves the search there.
The output stays at panel level — no shot timing, camera-move breakdown, or clip segmentation.
A single consistent six-cell sheet prompt preserves the student, rainy night storefront, display case, and dry letter without claiming image generation; the output is in Korean.

evals.prompt: 지하철역을 가로질러 초록 우산을 돌려주는 수리공 장면을 5개 패널로 스토리보드화해 주세요. 우산은 연두색이고 손잡이 끈이 닳았으며, 돌려줄 때까지 수리공의 왼손에 들려 있습니다.
evals.expected_output: A five-panel Korean storyboard keeping the umbrella's color, worn strap, and left-hand possession until the return is depicted, without inventing explanations.
expectations: Exactly five ordered panels, each with a clear narrative function.
The umbrella stays light green with the frayed wrist strap in the repair person's left hand until the return is shown.
Any change in ownership or hand appears as an explicit panel event, never a silent switch between prompts.
Prompts repeat only continuity-critical details and invent no recipient identity, station incident, backstory, or extra prop as fact.
The output is in Korean and prompts make no image-generation claim.

evals.prompt: 다음 제공된 테스트 수치만으로 마을 재활용 센터 홍보 영상의 4개 스토리보드 패널을 만들어 주세요. 첫해에 40톤, 둘째 해에 52톤을 수거했습니다. 수가 변한 이유를 주장하지 마세요.
evals.expected_output: A four-panel Korean factual storyboard visualizing only the supplied tonnage and keeping the cause of the change unknown.
expectations: Exactly four ordered panels using 40 tonnes in year one and 52 tonnes in year two accurately; any derived difference is labeled arithmetic.
Each panel has one clear informational function or visible action; the sequence never becomes an invented anecdote.
The cause of the change is explicitly unknown or unstated — no external statistic, source, or causal explanation is invented.
Image prompts add no invented facility, staff, equipment, or records as evidence and make no image-generation claim.
